name: Yellow-fringed Dolichomia Moth
desc: Yellow-fringed Dolichomia Moth (Hypsopygia olinalis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 68 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hypsopygia olinalis, the yellow-fringed dolichomia, is a moth of the family Pyralidae. It is found in eastern North America.
